description_en: Uploads a media stream file based on the URL of the source file
description_zh: 调用UploadStreamByURL基于源文件URL，拉取媒体流文件并上传至VOD点播存储中。上传完成后，该媒体流将自动挂载到指定的MediaId下
kebab_example: aliyun ice upload-stream-by-url --stream-url https://example.com/sample-stream.mp4 --media-id 411bed50018971edb60b0764a0ec6000 --definition HD --file-extension mp4 --hdr-type HDR10 --user-data MessageCallback_:_CallbackURL_:_http://test.test.com_,_Extend_:_localId_:_xxx_,_test_:_www --region cn-hangzhou
name: UploadStreamByURL

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the transcoded stream file.

If the URL of the transcoded stream requires authentication, you must specify the authentication parameters in the stream URL and make sure that the URL can be accessed over the Internet
parameters.help_zh:
转码流文件URL。

如果转码流的URL需要鉴权，需要在StreamURL中传入鉴权参数，并确保该URL可以通过公网访问
parameters.name: stream_url

parameters.help_en: The ID of the media asset
parameters.name: media_id

parameters.help_en:
The quality of the media stream. Valid values:

- FD: low definition.

- LD: standard definition.

- SD: high definition.

- HD: ultra-high definition.

- OD: original quality.

- 2K: 2K resolution.

- 4K: 4K resolution.

- SQ: standard sound quality.

- HQ: high sound quality
parameters.help_zh:
视频流清晰度定义。取值：
- FD：流畅。
- LD：标清。
- SD：高清。
- HD：超清
- OD：原画。
- 2K：2K。
- 4K：4K。
- SQ：普通音质。
- HQ：高音质
parameters.name: definition

parameters.help_en: The file name extension of the media stream
parameters.name: file_extension

parameters.help_en:
The high dynamic range (HDR) format of the transcoded stream. Valid values:

- HDR

- HDR10

- HLG

- DolbyVision

- HDRVivid

- SDR+

>

- The value is not case-sensitive,

- You can leave this parameter empty for non-HDR streams
parameters.help_zh:
转码流HDR类型。取值：
- HDR
- HDR10
- HLG
- DolbyVision
- HDRVivid
- SDR+
> - 大小写不敏感。
> - 非HDR视频该参数为空即可
parameters.name: hdr_type
